directive_basis: R404 item 9: CLAIM -> SOURCE -> EVIDENCE_CLASS -> VERIFICATION -> UNKNOWN -> EXPERIMENT for every important claim; a buyer can inspect why every important sentence exists.
scope: The important claims as they stand in the buyer sequence + canonical records. Every UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN (Art. XXV); no claim is promoted by documentation.

rows.claim: Single-ended piezoresistive sensors drift (typical 1-10 mmHg/month class)
rows.source: external precedent literature cited in the frozen dossier (incl. S0924424724006095)
rows.verification: literature-cited range; not re-measured by the engine
rows.unknown: the specific achievable drift of THIS die design
rows.experiment: the paired-die benchmark measures both arms directly

rows.claim: The self-referencing bridge cancels COMMON-MODE (thermal) drift
rows.source: V_out = (R_active - R_dummy)/(4R)*V_ex bridge equation (frozen dossier) + the P-25 in-model measurement (67.8 % cancellation)
rows.verification: the cancellation was MEASURED IN-MODEL at R337 on the predecessor — the physics of common-mode cancellation worked; it is the residual that failed
rows.unknown: whether the cancellation ratio holds for the current die geometry
rows.experiment: thermal-sweep arm of the paired-die benchmark (both arms, same instrument)

rows.claim: NON-COMMON-MODE drift is NOT compensated — the predecessor's measured kill channel (biofouling + asymmetric creep)
rows.source: P-25 failure record: R337 audit (3.45 mmHg residual vs 2.0 threshold; biofouling 3 µV/day on the exposed element only) + R347 cemetery KA-P-25-CEMETERY-001/DC-P-25-001 + LINEAGE_AUDIT.json
rows.evidence_class: COMPUTATIONAL_RESULT (historical in-model measurement) + codified cemetery lesson (KA-014 class)
rows.verification: the failure is preserved in history (R337/R347/R370J); the R404 lineage audit restores it to the canonical record after its erasure from the frozen buyer dossier (biofouling 0 mentions there)
rows.unknown: whether recalibration/anti-fouling can hold error below threshold — the P-25 open boundary condition, STILL OPEN
rows.experiment: the fouling-exposure arm of the paired-die benchmark — designed to measure exactly this channel

rows.evidence_class: MODEL_DERIVED target (dossier label: 'MODELLED — no hardware validation')
rows.verification: target provenance declared MODEL_DERIVED per Art. XXVII; acceptance threshold for the benchmark must be pre-registered with provenance, NOT borrowed from P-25's cancelled numbers
rows.experiment: primary endpoint of the paired-die benchmark (improvement ratio)

rows.claim: Shipped CAD valid (sensor die 0.07 mm diaphragm + reference die + carrier)
rows.source: geometry gate battery + R404 independent re-run (GEOMETRY_REVERIFICATION_EVIDENCE.json)
rows.verification: fresh deterministic rebuild: ALL gates satisfied; diaphragm 0.12 -> 0.07 KEEP reproduced
rows.unknown: MEMS process for a catheter-integrated 0.07 mm diaphragm (unvalidated)

rows.claim: No prior-art search artifact exists for THIS technology (REPORTED by management, UNLOCATED in the full reachable history)
rows.source: NOVELTY_ASSESSMENT.json (NOVELTY_SEARCH_REPORTED + SOURCE_ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE) — full git-history + artifact-archive search at R403 AND re-verified at R404
rows.evidence_class: ABSENCE-OF-ARTIFACT (honest state; NOT 'never performed', Art. XXI.3/XXV)
rows.verification: exhaustive search: working tree, all branches, archive branch, restored artifacts, 189 patent/novelty-named files in history — none targets this technology's queries
rows.unknown: the searches management reports may exist outside the repository
rows.experiment: fresh prior-art search (the cheap parallel owner action)

rows.source: BENCHMARK_SPECIFICATION.json language guard (forbidden-terms list, referenced not quoted)
